rules.question: Which activation stands on a fill the path took?
rules.owner: PreviewActivation::taken_fill in src/app/preview_view.h, which apply_preview_overlay sets when it marks the fill Taken
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md, "Engine truth": every reader of the fill's state reads what the overlay wrote; found by the PB-5 review
rules.note: The overlay writes the fill a taken activation stands on into PreviewActivation::taken_fill, so a screen that wants the step behind a Taken fill reads that field and never matches the two ticks itself. A candidate's act_tick against a fill's chord_tick is a different question (which fill a priced candidate belongs to) and the pattern does not match it.

rules.question: Which fill rides on the chord at a tick?
rules.owner: fill_on_chord in src/app/preview_view.cpp, which apply_preview_overlay and fill_index_on_chord both use
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-30-path-builder-redesign.md, "Engine truth": every reader of the fills reads what the overlay wrote; found by the PB-5 review

owner_lines.line_text: if (from >= fills.size() || fills[from].chord_tick != tick) return std::nullopt;

rules.note: A screen that wants the fill on a tick calls app::fill_index_on_chord, which asks fill_on_chord, and never walks scene.fills comparing ticks. The ordered walk in fill_on_chord stops at the first fill at or past the tick, so its own `<` test is not matched.
